## v0.8.1 — Header wording

Rename the top bar from “chrome” to **header** in the UI docs and firmware identifiers. Behavior is unchanged.

The header is the top bar: app name, page dots, and battery. Focus it with `↑` from the top of an app, then `←` `→` to switch apps.

Firmware and Companion are both **0.8.1** (Companion versionCode 3).

Serial boot line: `cardputer_adv_firmware 0.8.1`

**Full diff:** https://github.com/bluedskim/cardputer_adv_firmware/compare/v0.8.0...v0.8.1
